Jurassic Finance Labs is proud to announce Yinan Wang (@fossillocator) as the third and final of three advisors supporting the core team in bringing tokenized dinosaurs to @Solana.

A Princeton-trained geologist, Yinan has spent two decades in the natural history industry and is the author of the award-winning 50 States Geoscience series; guidebooks on fossils, gems and minerals, and meteorites that have introduced a generation of young collectors to the field. He brings deep technical expertise and a rare network of connections to dinosaur suppliers across the US.

Mr. Wang will help authenticate and verify specimens, conduct provenance and background checks, and recommend offloading pathways for any dinosaurs that head to Jurassic Finance Labs.

Mr. Wang will receive 1% of Jurassic Finance Labs, drawn entirely from the core team's Performance Package, and bound by the same unlock conditions.

Jurassic Finance Labs is proud to announce Rob Petrozzo (@robpetrozzo, Co-founder and Chief Product Officer at @OnRallyRd) as the second of three advisors supporting the core team in bringing tokenized dinosaurs to @Solana.

Rob helped build Rally, the first regulated retail platform for fractional ownership of rare collectibles, spanning classic cars, sports memorabilia, watches, sneakers, and dinosaurs.

Mr. Petrozzo will receive 1% of Jurassic Finance Labs, allocated entirely from the core team’s Performance Package, and tied to the same unlock conditions.
